slides.headline: GPT-6 Astra is here and OpenAI is calling it AGI
slides.body: The model scores 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4 and 99.9% on ARC-AGI 3. OpenAI says it's the best model in the world for computer use, coding, and science, and its own president Greg Brockman is calling it AGI

slides.headline: Senator Bernie Sanders just introduced a bill to ban superintelligent AI
slides.body: The bill would permanently make it illegal to build or deploy any AI that exceeds human intelligence. Get caught and you're looking at up to 20 years in prison

slides.headline: OpenAI admitted the GPT-6 Astra launch was a complete mess
slides.body: The company apologized for the chaotic rollout and said most users still don't have access. ChatGPT Pro subscribers get in first, broad API rollout is coming 'in the near future' with no date set

slides.headline: Tesla's Cybercab is driving around Austin with no wheel and no pedals
slides.body: Tesla's Cybercab is operating as a fully driverless commercial robotaxi, with no driver seat controls at all. It's already on public roads in Austin, Texas

slides.headline: Google's WeatherNext 3 just changed how we predict weather
slides.body: The model learns directly from real-world, real-time observations to give more localized, highly accurate predictions faster. It was built with Google Research and outperforms traditional numerical weather models on localized forecast accuracy

slides.headline: SAVE TODAY'S AI BRIEFING

caption:
